faq.q: What is the origin of Bilqis?
faq.a: Bilqis is associated with Arabic. Bilqīs, the name traditionally given to the Queen of Sheba. The source record's gloss 'Queen of Sheba, Wise Queen' is a reasonable rendering.
Yes — the underlying form بلقيس is Arabic.
Bilqis can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Bilqis should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The Queen of Sheba is referred to in the Qur'an (27:23-44) but is not named there
